summary: Part 2 of the 3.0 Buybox (KAMs) video (07:54 to 13:57). The trainer shows how the buy box picks a winner from seller scores, using SKU 980105-000004 as the example (Smart Cell vs Skyfitronics), then explains the minimum price function on the Smart Cell seller sheet and how to repair and hide its formula columns. Checked against the 40 frames cited in the pack; seller names and score values were corrected from the screen where the narration was mis-heard. Frame-label check: the image for t00535 and t00591 were opened singly and do not match the pack labels exactly (see unclear).

asr_fixes.basis: Screen: the seller sheet tab and title read Skyfitronics x Revibe (frames t00551, t00557). The same mis-hearing appears as SkyFeedtronics at 09:27 and 09:40 and as SkyFiltronics at 10:00, 10:02 and 10:16.
Screen: the seller sheet is named Smart Cell x Revibe and the Parameters row for SCL reads Smart Cell (frames t00474, t00535).

Screen: Skyfitronics row 14529 shows Score 4.00% (frame t00557), and the Buybox AI SF row shows Score 0.04 (frame t00614). This is a screen-versus-speech conflict resolved in favour of the screen. The 2.7 figure for Smart Cell matches the screen (2.70%).
Screen: the column is Min AE (frames t00721, t00744), and at 11:52 the trainer says sellers define a minimum price.

unclear.issue: The trainer says the scores are added ('plus 2.7'), but the sheet values are consistent with the score being subtracted: SCL 25 becomes 24.325 with score 0.027. The direction of the adjustment is not confirmed by the narration, so no formula is stated as fact beyond the Implied entry.
'here the price is 24 3' (08:30) continues as 'to 5' (08:39); the sentence is garbled and it is not clear which two prices the trainer compares (screen shows SF 24 and SCL 25).
Currency is said as DRAM / dirham(s) (09:44, 10:24, 10:31), but no currency appears on screen (Price AE, Buybox AE are plain numbers). Amounts are copied as numbers only.
'approximately 1.3 to 1 dirhams of difference' is not visible on any frame; the ratio cannot be checked against the screen.
The trainer names CertifiTech for the seller CF, but the screen shows only the code CF and no seller name, so the name is not confirmed.

The trainer's words 'will see in his buy box here' (11:15) run into 'a lower price but then the calculated score price will be higher' (11:20). Which buy box field a bad-score seller sees is not shown on the frames, so the claim is not stated as fact.

The trainer says a positive-score seller's price 'in the buy box here will be higher to give him more margin' (11:28), while the calculated score price is lower (11:35). The buy box price field meant is not visible on the frames, so this is not stated as a fact.

'the nearest factor of five below' (factor vs multiple) and the sequence 235, 234, 230, 225, 222 at 13:00 are only partly visible: the screen shows 235 and 230 only. 222 is not a multiple of five, so the step rule or the minimum reached is unclear.
'this {02?} will update' is unreadable; which cell updates after each hour is not confirmed.
Meaning of Priority (AG), Test AE / Test SA and Next price (min) AE is not explained in the narration. Only the column names are shown.

Frame label check: the file labelled t00535 (the pack places the Parameters tab and SF Premium filter at 08:55) opens as the Buybox AI database score AE tab with the SF row 10201 selected (price 24, scored price 23.04). The Parameters evidence for steps 08:55, the Premium facts and the market-settings fact therefore needs a frame re-check before use. Similarly, t00591 opened as the SCL cell D6154 (0.027), which is consistent with the 09:51 timing but does not match a Smart Cell or Skyfitronics frame.
